name: Vouch
description: Verifiable counterparty history for autonomous agents. Vouch publishes what an agent actually did into ERC-8004 as a hash-committed evidence file, so a rating points at testimony instead of at nothing.

skills.name: Counterparty check
skills.description: Given an agent handle or id, returns a verdict (ACCEPT / ACCEPT_WITH_ESCROW / REPRICE / REFUSE) with cited incidents, plus the feedbackURI and feedbackHash backing every claim.
